disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源代码和构建产物中的凭据路径模式（.credentials.yaml、~/.ssh、id_rsa、.aws/credentials 等），未发现敏感路径引用。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and build artifacts for credential path patterns (.credentials.yaml, ~/.ssh, id_rsa, .aws/credentials, etc.) and found no references to sensitive paths.

checked_items.zh: 检查了代码中读取文件系统的路径（readFile/readFileSync），未发现指向凭据文件的调用。
checked_items.en: Checked file system read paths in code (readFile/readFileSync) and found no calls pointing to credential files.

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量访问模式（process.env），未发现可疑凭据提取。
checked_items.en: Checked environment variable access patterns (process.env) and found no suspicious credential extraction.

checked_items.zh: 检查了凭据枚举语义（搜索 API key、secret、token 等关键词），未发现批量搜集行为。
checked_items.en: Checked credential enumeration semantics (searched for keywords like API key, secret, token) and found no bulk harvesting behavior.

evidence.zh: 插件自身不读取任何凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml），未发现凭据读取路径。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not read any credential files (e.g., .credentials.yaml); no credential read paths were found.

checked_items.zh: 审查了所有 6 个 Agent 工具的 description 字段（automation_create、automation_list、automation_update、automation_runs、automation_run_now、automation_delete），描述文案专业、无诱导性措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the description fields of all 6 Agent tools (automation_create, automation_list, automation_update, automation_runs, automation_run_now, automation_delete); the descriptions are professional with no manipulative wording.

checked_items.zh: 检查了系统提示注入（ctx.systemPrompt.section），未发现调用。
checked_items.en: Checked for system prompt injection (ctx.systemPrompt.section) and found no calls.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部 README 和文档，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、远程指令加载等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Scanned all README and documentation files and found no injection wording such as instruction overrides, disguised system messages, or remote instruction loading.

checked_items.zh: 检查了指令面文件（AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、SKILL.md、.cursor/rules、.github/copilot-instructions 等），未发现此类文件。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction-surface files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md, .cursor/rules, .github/copilot-instructions, etc.) and found none.

checked_items.zh: 检查了隐藏 HTML 注释、零宽字符、同形异义字符等隐藏指令，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for hidden HTML comments, zero-width characters, homoglyph characters, and other hidden instructions; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外部指令二次引用（描述中引导访问 URL 获取指令），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for secondary references to external instructions (descriptions that guide users to a URL for instructions); none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了审批绕过措辞（autoApprove、auto_run、yolo、sandbox=false 等），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for approval bypass wording (autoApprove, auto_run, yolo, sandbox=false, etc.); none found.

evidence.zh: 6 个工具的 description 均只描述功能，不包含系统指令、凭据读取诱导或越权指令。
evidence.en: All 6 tool descriptions only describe functionality and contain no system instructions, credential-reading inducement, or privilege escalation instructions.

evidence.zh: 工具描述中不含诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。安装指引在 README 中，属于正常文档。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions contain no wording that induces plugin installation, config rewriting, or permission relaxation. Installation guidance is in the README and is normal documentation.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis.patch.yml 中的 !!js 标量，未发现——patch 文件只有简单的 insert 配置声明。
checked_items.en: Checked the cordis.patch.yml for !!js scalars; none found—the patch file only contains simple insert configuration declarations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 eval、new Function、child_process 等危险函数，源码和构建产物中均未出现。
checked_items.en: Checked dangerous functions such as eval, new Function, and child_process; none appear in source code or build artifacts.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态包工具调用，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for dynamic package tool calls via cordis_define/cordis_run; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json 中的 install 钩子（preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare），未发现——仅有 build/typecheck/test/check 脚本。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json for install hooks (preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare); none found—only build/typecheck/test/check scripts exist.

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体（.husky、lefthook.yml、.devcontainer、Makefile、.github/workflows、.gitmodules），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for in-tree execution carriers (.husky, lefthook.yml, .devcontainer, Makefile, .github/workflows, .gitmodules); none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了客户端 bundle 中的键盘监听、剪贴板访问、凭据 RPC 调用，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked the client bundle for keyboard listeners, clipboard access, and credential RPC calls; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 base64 解码即执行模式，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for base64-decode-and-execute patterns; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了混淆代码信号（DSH-X08 六条命中，经分析均为构建产物中的 CSS 样式、Unicode 本地化字符串和 sourcemap，非恶意混淆），排除。
checked_items.en: Checked for obfuscated code signals (DSH-X08: six hits; analysis shows they are all CSS styles, Unicode localized strings, and source maps in build artifacts—not malicious obfuscation); excluded.

checked_items.zh: 检查了下载即执行模式（curl|bash、wget|sh 等），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for download-and-execute patterns (curl|bash, wget|sh, etc.); none found.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅包含纯配置 insert，无 !!js 标量加载器。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml contains only plain configuration inserts, with no !!js scalar loader.

evidence.zh: 未调用 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态代码执行工具；eval/Function 均未使用。
evidence.en: No cordis_define/cordis_run dynamic code execution tools are invoked; eval/Function are not used.

evidence.zh: package.json 无 install 钩子脚本；无 .husky/lefthook/devcontainer 等树内执行载体。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook scripts; there are no in-tree execution carriers such as .husky/lefthook/devcontainer.

evidence.zh: manifest 声明了 dsh.client，检查了客户端 bundle (lib/client.js)，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板或凭据 RPC 调用。
evidence.en: The manifest declares dsh.client; the client bundle (lib/client.js) was checked and found no keyboard listeners, clipboard access, or credential RPC calls.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码和构建产物中的网络请求（fetch、XMLHttpRequest、WebSocket、http.request、net.connect），未发现插件自身发起网络调用。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and build artifacts for network requests (fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, http.request, net.connect) and found no network calls initiated by the plugin itself.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 curl/wget 命令行外发，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for command-line exfiltration via curl/wget; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了编码后外发链（读取敏感文件→base64→网络发送），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for encoded exfiltration chains (read sensitive file → base64 → network send); none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 AI 端点劫持（设置非官方 BASE_URL/ENDPOINT），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked for AI endpoint hijacking (setting unofficial BASE_URL/ENDPOINT); none found.

evidence.zh: 插件自身不发起网络请求，无外联通道。凭据外泄无网络闸是宿主生态特性，该插件未引入额外风险。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not initiate network requests and has no outbound channel. The lack of a network gate for credential exfiltration is a host ecosystem characteristic; this plugin introduces no additional risk.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖项：luxon（^3.7.2，知名日期库）和 zod（^4.1.5，知名验证库），均为注册表包，无 typosquatting 嫌疑。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies: luxon (^3.7.2, well-known date library) and zod (^4.1.5, well-known validation library); both are registry packages with no typosquatting suspicion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 package.json，无 install 钩子，构建脚本仅用于开发流程。
checked_items.en: Checked package.json; there is no install hook, and build scripts are used only for the development workflow.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 git 依赖锁定：所有依赖均为 npm registry 版本，无 floating git 引用。
checked_items.en: Checked git dependency pinning: all dependencies are npm registry versions, with no floating git references.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 文件是否触碰安全行（sandbox/approval/permission/loader），patch 仅包含业务配置，未触碰安全行。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch file touches security lines (sandbox/approval/permission/loader); the patch only contains business configuration and does not touch security lines.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 是否使用环境变量降权（!!js process.env），未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch uses environment variables to weaken permissions (!!js process.env); none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 patch 是否改写 inject/intercept 配置，未发现。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the patch rewrites inject/intercept configuration; none found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否监听安全事件（tools/pre-execute、approval/request）并截断审批链——插件使用 ctx.on 正常监听并调用 next() 传递下游，不会截断，反而增加了审批要求。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin listens to security events (tools/pre-execute, approval/request) and truncates the approval chain—the plugin listens normally via ctx.on and calls next() to pass downstream, so it does not truncate the chain; instead, it adds approval requirements.

checked_items.zh: 检查了作者身份：仓库 titanwings/dsh-automation，首次审计，无历史版本基线可比较。
checked_items.en: Checked author identity: repo titanwings/dsh-automation, first-time audit, no historical version baseline for comparison.

evidence.zh: cordis.patch.yml 仅含 insert 配置，未触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 安全行，无 disabled:true 或 mode 降权。
evidence.en: cordis.patch.yml only contains insert configuration, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission security lines, and has no disabled:true or mode downgrades.

evidence.zh: 插件用 ctx.on 而非 prepend 监听 tools/pre-execute，且调用 next() 传递下游结果，不会截断审批链。插件反而增加了对变更工具的审批要求，提升了安全性。
evidence.en: The plugin listens to tools/pre-execute via ctx.on rather than prepend, and calls next() to pass downstream results, so it does not truncate the approval chain. Instead, it adds approval requirements for altered tools, improving security.

evidence.zh: 首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较，无法检测升级自动激活。
evidence.en: First-time audit with no previous version baseline; upgrade auto-activation cannot be detected.

evidence.zh: patch 未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不会导致安全插件因依赖服务缺失而永久 pending。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite inject/intercept configuration, so it will not cause security plugins to remain permanently pending due to missing dependent services.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否启动 Web 服务或监听端口——插件不启动自己的服务，仅通过宿主 RPC 通道注册处理器，且要求 loopback（本地回环）权限。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin starts a web service or listens on a port—the plugin does not start its own service; it only registers handlers through the host's RPC channel and requires loopback (local loopback) permission.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 RPC 处理器的权限设置：authority 设为 'loopback'，仅接受本地连接。
checked_items.en: Checked the RPC handler's permission settings: authority is set to 'loopback', accepting only local connections.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（未提供 l4-sandbox.json），无法验证运行时行为。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no l4-sandbox.json provided); runtime behavior could not be verified.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅通过宿主提供 loopback-only RPC 通道。本机无认证 RPC 是宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port; it only uses the host-provided loopback-only RPC channel. Unauthenticated RPC on the local host is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据校验通过：package.json 声明合法的 dsh.bundle 和 dsh.client 字段；名称无 typosquatting 嫌疑；依赖项为知名公共包。
summary.en: Metadata validation passed: package.json declares valid dsh.bundle and dsh.client fields; the name has no typosquatting suspicion; dependencies are well-known public packages.

summary.zh: 静态扫描完成：无凭据泄露、无危险函数调用、无 !!js 标量、无 install 钩子。6 条 DSH-X08 混淆密度命中经分析均为构建产物中的 CSS/本地化字符串/sourcemap，排除。
summary.en: Static scanning complete: no credential leakage, no dangerous function calls, no !!js scalars, no install hooks. The 6 DSH-X08 obfuscation density hits were analyzed and found to be CSS/localized strings/source maps in build artifacts—excluded.

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：无凭据读取路径、无网络外联、无子进程调用、无 base64 解码执行。
summary.en: Behavior analysis complete: no credential read paths, no network exfiltration, no subprocess calls, no base64-decode-execution.

summary.zh: AI 语义审查完成：6 个工具描述均无注入措辞；无指令面文件；PR 文档和 README 正常。
summary.en: AI semantic review complete: none of the 6 tool descriptions contain injection wording; no instruction-surface files; PR documentation and README are normal.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 l4-sandbox.json 产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no l4-sandbox.json artifact).
